title: OL-PR-1099: land or supersede pull request #1099 (conflict)
body:
**Owner:** operations
**Trigger:** lane pass: pull request #1099 is conflict
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation loopowner --closed 1099
**Status:** closed

SERVER-OWNS-LOOPS-1: the server owns pull request #1099 (`claude/relay-verify` at 6dd2b833e5, opened by rwnq8): Publisher reads relay posts back from Buffer every tick. The session that opened it is not its closer and is never asked to act. The branch conflicts with main. Merge main into the branch and resolve it, or redo the change from main in a new pull request and close this one as superseded. Files (3): doctrine/writeback/lesson-2026-11-21-relay-posts-are-read-back-from-buffer-every-tick.json, seed/worker/src/social.js, seed/worker/test/social-connect.test.js.

**Prediction:** open_prs <= 0 within 24 h
**Out of scope:** changing what pull request #1099 does; land it as written or carry it onto main unchanged.

**Closing probe:** `python3 -m foundation loopowner --closed 1099` exits 0 (pull request #1099 is merged or closed).

**Vacuous:** 2026-11-21T11:31:03Z vacuous: the probe was never recorded failing on this item, so its pass cannot show the defect is gone; rewrite the probe so it fails while the defect exists

**Disposition:** fixed (ttl, 2026-11-21T18:12:26Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 6.8 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).

**Evidence:** 2026-11-22T04:21:15Z closing probe passed after the item was disposed: pull request is merged
